english.note: This is the all-purpose word for disciplinary punishment imposed by a parent, teacher, or other authority.
This is the all-purpose choice for a punishment imposed by law, rules, or a sports official, but not for a penalty kick or an early-withdrawal charge.

examples.english: After getting his homework wrong so many times, the teacher decided on punishment.
examples.traditional: 做錯咁多次功課，老師決定要懲罰佢。
examples.jyutping: zou6 co3 gam3 do1 ci3 gung1 fo3 lou5 si1 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 cing4 fat6 keoi5

examples.english: A prison sentence was the penalty for his crime.
